questions.question: When Aram kept crushing Israel, what did King Jehoahaz of Israel do?

answers.text: He sought the favor of the LORD
He sent gold to King Hazael
He asked Egypt to send help

questions.question: When King Jehoash of Israel struck the ground with arrows only three times, how did the prophet Elisha react?

answers.text: He was angry with the king

questions.question: After the prophet Elisha died, a dead man's body touched his bones and the man came back to life. True or false?
Why did the LORD show compassion to Israel and refuse to destroy them?

answers.text: His covenant with Abraham Isaac and Jacob
The sacrifices offered at the altar in Bethel
Israel's promise to turn from Jeroboam's sins
